title_sq: Apartament 2+1+2 te Ekspozita Building & Post Parkimi
description_sq:
Shitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 ne kompleksin "Ekspozita Building".
Ky ndertim ka nje pozicion strategjik buze Bulevardit Gjergj Fishta dhe karakterizohet nga cilesi e larte e ndertimit dhe arkitektura unike. Ndertim premium per qytetin e Tiranes eshte i nderthurur me njesi sherbimesh komerciale, ambiente per zyra si dhe apartamente. Apartamenti ne fjale ka siperfaqe totale 186.89 m2 dhe organizohet ne korridorin hyres i cili ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit teper i bollshem dhe me pamje spektakolare, totalisht me fasade xhami, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhoma e femijeve dhe tualeti i dites.
Ne cmim jane te perfshire edhe 2 poste parkimi.
Per me shume informacion dhe nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 in Exhibition Building & Post Parking
description_en: 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale in the "Exhibition Building" complex. This building has a strategic position on the edge of Gjergj Fishta Boulevard and is characterized by high quality construction and unique architecture. Premium building for the city of Tirana is interspersed with commercial service units, office premises and apartments. The apartment in question has a total area of ​​186.89 m2 and is organized in the entrance corridor which divides the premises, the living room together with the very spacious kitchen corner and with a spectacular view, completely with glass facades, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room and a day toilet. The price includes 2 parking spaces. For more information and a visit to the property, contact us!
